item.description:
# CodexSwitchMenu 4.5.0
- Added signed in-app update checks and installation using Sparkle. - Automatic checks run once a day. Automatic installation is optional and off by default. - Updating restarts only the menu-bar app and waits for account operations to finish. - Universal build for Apple Silicon and Intel, macOS 13 or later. - Includes the Goal recovery fixes from 4.4.1; that feature remains experimental.
First installation is manual because older builds do not contain an updater. This build is ad-hoc signed, not notarized by Apple; see the repository's installation notes.
